# Jobibi — Project Build Progress

**Current state:** Phase 2 — S5c shipped (S1–S5c on branch `fm/jobibi-s5c-sensitive-fields`, off `main` at `f359467`). S6 (Capture — the growth loop) is next.

- 2026-08-09 — Product vision received; stack locked (DECISIONS D1–D4: Chrome extension, cloud memory on Supabase, payments deferred, JobStreet/LinkedIn/Indeed first).
- 2026-08-09 — Documentation drafted (PRODUCT, ARCHITECTURE, DECISIONS, build plan v0.1).
- 2026-08-09 — **Design grill completed. 15 decisions taken; docs revised throughout.** Added CONTEXT.md (shared vocabulary). DECISIONS gained D10–D18 and D5 split into D5a/D5b/D5c. Build plan reordered.

## What the grill changed

**The gate has three outcomes, not two** (D10). Draft / **ask** / refuse, decided by code — the model is never consulted on refusal, and is only used to word a gap question after code has decided to ask. This is the largest change: it moves interview machinery from Phase 4 into Phase 2 and turns the cold-start problem into the growth mechanism.

**Model vendor decided: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna** (D5b), after evaluating Claude Sonnet 5, Mistral Large 3, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K3, and Claude Fable 5. Cost per 20-question application drops from the estimated $0.20–0.30 to **≈$0.012**, which effectively unblocks D8.

**Capture became central and got a safety guard** (D12, D13, D16). Field values are read back at submit; every stored answer records how it was produced, so the style profile never learns Jobibi's own prose back from itself; and the question→field mapping is re-derived at capture to stop a broken adapter from silently corrupting memory.

**Copy cards carry a skeleton as well as a draft** (D14), and the anti-detection claim in PRODUCT.md softened to authenticity of substance — grounding defeats cross-applicant correlation, which is largely not what detection tooling reads.

**Gate calibration has a plan** (D15): relative scoring against each user's own distribution, an absolute floor underneath, tuned against a hand-built 50-case fixture that also serves as the unit test — which unblocks the core-loop slice without needing users.

A build bug (WXT's Vite `envDir` defaulting to `apps/extension` instead of the monorepo root, so real Supabase credentials never reached the bundle) was caught by manual testing and fixed. - 2026-08-10 — **S3 completed.** `documents`, `memory_chunks`, and `sensitive_facts` tables migrated via the Supabase CLI (RLS-enabled from creation, matching the S2 pattern), plus a private `documents` Storage bucket scoped per-user by folder. A new `ingest` Edge Function extracts text (txt directly, docx via a hand-rolled zip+XML text-run parser, pdf via `unpdf`), chunks it (`packages/shared/src/ingestion/chunk.ts`), embeds each chunk in-process with the Edge Runtime's built-in gte-small model (D5c — no network call), and writes `documents` + `memory_chunks` rows, all under the caller's own JWT (no service-role writes). The side panel gained an upload flow, the sixty-second four-fact intake (writing directly to `sensitive_facts` under RLS), and a debug list showing documents/chunk counts/facts. Chunking and extraction are unit-tested (21 cases, including a programmatically-built minimal PDF fixture so no binary fixture is checked in). Verified against the real linked project: a scripted two-user check confirmed cross-user Storage RLS rejects writes into another user's folder, upload→ingest produced a resume's chunks with 384-dim embeddings, and the four facts round-tripped — then the test data was deleted.

- 2026-08-11 — **S5b completed** on branch `fm/jobibi-s5b-ask-path`. The gate's third outcome, end to end. `supabase/migrations/20260811000001_gap_answers.sql` adds `gap_answers` (RLS, `question_asked`, `answer_text`, `anchored_chunk_id` fk `memory_chunks`, `original_question_norm`, `application_id`). `supabase/functions/suggest/index.ts` now branches on `ask`: anchors to `scored[0].row`, words a one-line gap question via Luna (`generateGapQuestion`, JSON schema, `MAX_GAP_QUESTION_CHARS=180`) with a code-only fallback (`buildFallbackGapQuestion`), never asking the model to decide (D10). New Edge Function `supabase/functions/gap-answer` validates the answer, inserts `gap_answers`, embeds it (gte-small) into `memory_chunks` (`type='gap_answer'`), then re-retrieves and drafts via Luna so the fresh answer is used immediately. `SuggestCard.tsx` renders the ask state (anchored excerpt, textarea, validation, `Submit & draft`) and the draft view notes when a follow-up answer was used. Two fixes applied before shipping (both found by live-headed verification scouts): the `suggest/index.ts` gap-question truncation could overflow the 180-char cap by one character on append-`?`, fixed to reserve room before slicing (matching the existing `generateGapQuestion` pattern); `gap-answer/index.ts` cast the embedding array to `string` instead of `JSON.stringify`-ing it before insert, fixed to match `suggest`'s own embedding handling. Migration and both Edge Functions deployed to `kbpojtjemftqwgmrnbdq` (`suggest` and `gap-answer` redeployed after the two fixes). Verified: `packages/shared` 56 passed, `apps/extension` 5 passed, `tsc --noEmit` 0, `wxt build` 453.61 kB, `check-manifest` ok; live headed round-trip (ask → `gap-answer` → draft) previously verified twice by scouts (static + live headed against real Supabase, `data/jobibi-s5b-live-headed-verification/report.md`). **Known, accepted gap:** `ROLE_THRESHOLD=0.35` in `packages/shared/src/gate/gate.ts` means live `roleMatch` never drops low enough for the natural gate to reach `ask` in production yet — captain's explicit decision is to ship as-is and recalibrate once `gate_decisions` telemetry accumulates, tracked as `jobibi-s5b-ask-threshold-recalibration` (target: S6, no later than just before S7).

- 2026-08-12 — **S5c completed** on branch `fm/jobibi-s5c-sensitive-fields`. Union sensitive-field detector in `packages/shared/src/gate/sensitive.ts` (D17): rule-based keyword match (`RULE_KEYWORDS`, deliberately narrow per kind) **or** retrieval match against the user's typed `sensitive_facts` (keyword-overlap stand-in for cosine similarity, `RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD=0.25`, with a `cosineScores` override path for the production embedding score) — either signal firing routes to always-confirm (`detectSensitiveUnion` + `buildProvenanceLine`), unit-tested (`sensitive.test.ts`, 7 cases) against a dedicated oblique-phrasing golden set (`sensitiveGoldenSet.ts`) proving retrieval catches long-tail phrasing the narrow rule list misses. `supabase/functions/suggest/index.ts` runs the check immediately after normalizing the question and *before* retrieval, the gate, or any Luna call; on a hit it returns a new `confirm` outcome (`sensitiveKind`, `sensitiveFact` with provenance, `sensitiveVia`) instead of drafting. New Edge Function `supabase/functions/sensitive-confirm` (wired into `supabase/config.toml`) handles `confirm` (bump `confirmed_at` on the existing row via UPDATE, falling back to INSERT if RLS has no UPDATE policy) and `update` (INSERT a fresh row with a new `stated_at` and `confirmed_at` cleared) — both scoped to the caller's own JWT. `SuggestCard.tsx` renders the violet always-confirm card with the provenance line and Confirm/Update actions, or an intake prompt when the user has no fact of that kind yet. Four fixes landed at ship time: `ab8eecf` removed a `?debugSensitive` URL-gated verification harness from the production bundle (its screenshots had already been captured) before it could ship to real users; `bc251a8` (no-mistakes review) scoped `sensitive-confirm`'s `factId` lookup by `kind` as well as `id`/`user_id`, closing a path where a caller-supplied `factId` for one kind could be confirmed under a different kind; `22e4328` made the `sensitive_facts` check in `suggest/index.ts` fail-closed per D17 (a DB/check error now returns `confirm` with no fact instead of falling through to gate/draft) and dropped the `kind: X via: Y` internal-detector-state line from the shipped card (via attribution stays in logs/telemetry only); `57e9ab1` (no-mistakes review) fixed the fail-closed path to check the Supabase query's `error` field instead of only `data` and added a distinct "couldn't verify, try Suggest again" state to the confirm card for when `sensitiveKind` is missing. Verified: `packages/shared` 63 tests passed (7 new), `tsc --noEmit` 0.

## Still open

- **D9** — business entity, blocking only for payments.
- Philippine Data Privacy Act review before public launch.
- **S5b ask-gate `ROLE_THRESHOLD` recalibration** — Live headed verification (data/jobibi-s5b-live-headed-verification/report.md §3.1, §6) found that `ROLE_THRESHOLD=0.35` in `packages/shared/src/gate/gate.ts` is miscalibrated: live `roleMatch` never dropped below 0.51 across 72 question×role combinations, so the `ask` gate outcome never fires in production; every request falls through to `draft`. Scheduled recalibration for S6 (no live `gate_decisions` telemetry yet to pick a better number), no later than just before S7 (new traffic sources will re-diversify the score distribution). S6 has no technical dependency on the ask path.

## All build blockers are now clear

D6, D7, and D8 are closed. Phase 1 authorized.

## Current state of the repo

S1, S2, S3, S3b, S4, S4.5, S5a, S5b, and S5c shipped (S4 `e423139`, S4.5 `f1ff005`, S5a `ac561be` → hotfixed `8c96860`, S5b on branch `fm/jobibi-s5b-ask-path`, S5c on branch `fm/jobibi-s5c-sensitive-fields`). The extension has auth, document upload or paste (cover letters only), four-fact intake, a memory-bank debug list, live JobStreet question extraction with confident field mapping, and per-question `Suggest` → grounded copy card (`answer + skeleton` + `Copy` buttons), amber refusal (never calls model on refuse), an anchored gap question that round-trips through `gap-answer` into a draft, or a violet always-confirm card for sensitive fields that never reaches Luna and writes confirm/update back to `sensitive_facts` via `sensitive-confirm`. Supabase has `profiles`, `documents`, `memory_chunks`, `sensitive_facts`, `gate_decisions`, `gap_answers` (all RLS-enabled), a private `documents` Storage bucket, and Edge Functions `ingest` + `suggest` + `gap-answer` + `sensitive-confirm` (all deployed, `OPENAI_API_KEY` set, length capped). Shared has the 50-case golden set, the sensitive-detection golden set, and two-axis gate (relative scoring, D15).

**Next step:** S6. Capture — the growth loop. `ROLE_THRESHOLD` recalibration (`jobibi-s5b-ask-threshold-recalibration`) is tracked separately and not a hard dependency for S6.
